name: Git Graph
description: View a graph of your Git history and run common Git actions from it. Based on neo-git-graph.

statusBarItems.tooltip: Git Graph keeps watching your repositories while this plugin is enabled.

settings.title: Center the commit details view
settings.description: Scroll the commit table so the expanded commit is centered in the view.

settings.title: Date format
settings.description: How dates are shown in the commit table.

settings.title: Date type
settings.description: Which date of a commit is shown.

settings.title: Graph colours
settings.description: Branch colours of the graph, separated by semicolons. Each is #RRGGBB, #RRGGBBAA or rgb(r, g, b).

settings.title: Graph style
settings.description: How the lines of the graph are drawn.

settings.title: Repository search depth
settings.description: How many folder levels below a workspace to look for Git repositories. 0 only checks the workspace folder itself.

settings.title: Show the current branch by default
settings.description: Show only the checked-out branch instead of all branches when a repository opens.

settings.title: Show uncommitted changes
settings.description: Show a row for uncommitted changes at the top of the graph.

settings.title: Speed up large repositories
settings.description: When a repository's graph is slow to open, write git's commit-graph file for it, once, in the background. It is one cache file under .git/objects/info that git also writes when it runs gc, and it is safe to delete. Turn this off to leave repositories untouched.

settings.title: Git executable
settings.description: Path to the git executable. Leave empty to use git from PATH.
